text:
tess: Quick incident - after flipping L7 payloads in eu2 for a compliance sample we saw a spike in keystore decrypt failures and GPU nodes stuck in Pending.
raj: Saw kubelet logs with `KMS ThrottlingException` during cloud-init decrypt. Snippet:
``nApr 06 04:12:03 kubelet[3421]: decrypt error: KMS ThrottlingException: GrantsPerSecondExceeded
```
anika: Metrics: keystore.decrypt/s jumped 6x. The audit path was set to direct S3 ingestion by the test and caused per-event decrypts.
sre_lead: Can we circuit-break the firewall policy automatically when decrypt error rate rises? Propose a short-term circuit-breaker: if keystore.decrypt/error_rate > 5% for 60s then set audit.l7_payload=false.
security_jen: Compliance ok with a temporary circuit-breaker if we document incident and re-run the sample via aggregator.
tess: I'll add a lock so scheduled experiments can opt-out of the auto-revert. Running the revert now.
raj: Command run: `fwctl set audit.l7_payload=false --region eu2 && fwctl sampling set 0.05 --region eu2`
ops-bot: Runbook triggered: keystore/repair-onboard. Steps posted. ETA 12m.
anika: After revert decrypt success rose from 61% -> 96% in about 7 minutes. Nodes joined.
sre_lead: Action items: 1) Implement circuit-breaker lambda + alarm 2) Route payloads via aggregator for batch decrypts 3) File KMS grant QPS increase request as fallback.
security_jen: I'll draft the compliance exception and timeline.
tess: Filing INFRA-1310 for the circuit-breaker and test plan. Closing loop: immediate revert stabilized onboarding; no customer impact observed.
